chunks: If evil befalls him he is perturbed;
ai.seo_question: What does the term 'jazoo'' mean in the context of Quranic descriptions of human nature?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the spiritual deficiency of those who, when struck by hardship, lose composure and become impatient, contrasting with the steadfastness (sabr) praised in the Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a diagnostic of the soul's reaction to divine decree, illustrating how the disbelievers' lack of deep faith manifests as frantic distress rather than trusting submission.
